manifest.name: dsh-bowmark
manifest.description: Connect Bowmark's remote MCP server to DeepSeek Harness. Typed functions for live websites; the API key stays in the BOWMARK_API_KEY credential.
manifest.author: Bowmark <support@bowmark.ai>

readme.text:
[](LICENSE)

> Community plugin for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness), maintained by Bowmark. Not an official DeepSeek product. MIT licensed.

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

Connects [Bowmark's hosted MCP server](https://bowmark.ai/docs) and registers the tools that server publishes. They show up as `mcp__bowmark__*`. With them the agent can search Bowmark's library of typed functions for live websites (`get_library`) and call them from a short script (`run`).

The agent can use Bowmark without a local `npx` process. The plugin reads an API key from the DSH credential store and hands a Streamable HTTP connection to the built-in `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client`. The key is not stored in `cordis.patch.yml`.

If the credential is empty, the plugin stays loaded and registers no Bowmark tools. Saving the credential reconnects.

1. Resolve `apiKeyEnv` (default `BOWMARK_API_KEY`) through `ctx.credentials`.
2. Connect to `https://api.bowmark.ai/mcp` with that key as `Authorization: Bearer`. The key is never put in the URL.
3. Mount one `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` child. Tool names, schemas and results come from the server.
4. When `credentials/reference-updated` fires for the same credential name, dispose that child and connect again.

Each tool call times out after 3 minutes.

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:bowmark-ai/dsh-bowmark
```

Restart DeepSeek Harness if the tools do not appear in the current session.

Make a free account at [bowmark.ai](https://bowmark.ai/sign-up) (it comes with a free $10 of usage), create a key at [bowmark.ai/dashboard/keys](https://bowmark.ai/dashboard/keys), then set the `BOWMARK_API_KEY` credential in this plugin's settings, or export the same name in the environment that launches DeepSeek Harness.

| Field | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `apiKeyEnv` | `BOWMARK_API_KEY` | Credential reference. The value is not kept in this config. |
| `url` | `https://api.bowmark.ai/mcp` | Remote MCP endpoint. `http` and `https` only, no user info. |
| `serverName` | `bowmark` | Namespace for tool names: `mcp__<serverName>__<tool>`. Must match `[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,32}`. |
See [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md). The key is sent only to the configured endpoint, as a bearer header.

- No `mcp__bowmark__*` tools: the `BOWMARK_API_KEY` credential is empty, or the session needs a restart.
- `401` in the log: the key was revoked or mistyped. Make a new one on the keys page.

```bash
npm test
npm run check
npm run check:pack
```

Adapted from [dsh-tavily-mcp](https://github.com/NingYuanLee/dsh-tavily-mcp) (MIT).
